release.decided: Paul, 14 Nov 2026: a deliberate exception to the release gate, released without waiting for the live shadow comparison verdict (docs/plan.md, Decisions: Master shortlist release).
release.switch: live: "new" = the new master rule (master_reconciliation, master-new-fill-rule-v4 with the fill and quote timing checks) writes master_shortlist.csv (version master-new-fill-rule-v4-live-v10) and the old master (version above) runs in shadow as master_shortlist_old.csv; "old" = the pre-release output byte for byte (old master in master_shortlist.csv, new master in shadow as master_shortlist_new.csv).

rollback.rule: After at least 150 graded matches over at least 3 calendar weeks on each list, compare flat-stake return per bet at Pinnacle prices, new master minus old master, whole kickoff weeks resampled (the same weeks for both), 95% interval. If the interval is entirely below zero, the weekly report says ROLLBACK TRIGGERED at the top and in the run summary. Nothing switches automatically: Paul decides, and rolling back is setting live to "old".
rollback.interval: the same 95% interval the live comparison computes (master_reconciliation_config.json, live_comparison: whole kickoff weeks resampled, its bootstrap samples and seed), so the report shows one interval

strong_release.decided: Paul, 23 Nov 2026: the strong-team master (master-strong-team-v1, plan Phase 4c) replaces today's master as master_shortlist.csv, a deliberate exception to the release gate (offline: no measurable difference from today's master; docs/plan.md, Decisions: Strong-team master release).
strong_release.switch: live: "strong" = the strong-team master writes master_shortlist.csv (version master-strong-team-v1-live-v11) and today's master (master-new-fill-rule-v4) runs in shadow as master_shortlist_new.csv, the comparison and rollback baseline; the old master (v9) is no longer written. "new" = rolled back: exactly the output before this release (today's master live, old master in shadow, strong master in shadow as master_shortlist_strong.csv).

rollback.rule: After at least 150 graded matches over at least 3 calendar weeks on each list, compare flat-stake return per bet at Pinnacle prices, strong master minus today's master, whole kickoff weeks resampled (the same weeks for both), 95% interval. If the interval is entirely below zero, the weekly report says ROLLBACK TRIGGERED at the top. Nothing switches automatically: Paul decides, and rolling back is setting live to "new".
rollback.interval: the strong master comparison's interval (master_strong_config.json live_comparison: whole kickoff weeks resampled, its bootstrap samples and seed)
